fact: On 2 July 2026 the Inspector General of Police launched the Liberia National Police Strategic Plan 2026 to 2030 in Monrovia and appealed to the government, the Legislature and partners to fund it, naming technology that modernizes investigations among its needs; the Solicitor General said the plan still had to follow a specific budget layout, and the article does not mention station records or any records system.
title: Coleman Launches LNP Reform Plan, Seeks Government and Partner Funding for Safer Liberia
